dct_title_s: Philippines Typhoons Toraji Usagi Man-yi: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2024
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Typhoons Toraji Usagi Man-yi: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Philippines Typhoons Toraji Usagi Man-yi (Nov 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Isabela Province, Philippines, Typhoons Toraji, Usagi & Man-yi, 19 Nov 2024, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Isabela Province, Philippines, Floods from Typhoons Toraji, Usagi & Man-yi, 19 Nov 2024, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024)
